_comment_project_name: No spaces — used as ChromaDB collection name. Use underscores.
_comment_extraction_path: Only used by evaluator/optimizer and evaluator/benchmark when their extraction hyperparameters are set — points to the extraction/ pipeline (process_docs.py) so extraction-parameter variants can be built on demand.

llm._comment_base_url: Full base URL for OpenAI-compatible API (include /v1 if needed). Examples: 'http://localhost:8080/v1' for LiteLLM, 'http://localhost:11434/v1' for Ollama
llm._comment_api_key: API key for LLM endpoint. Use 'dummy' for local models without auth. For API providers, use your actual key.
llm._comment_ssl: Path to SSL certificate bundle file (e.g., '/etc/ssl/certs/ca-bundle.crt' or '~/certificates/ca-bundle.crt'). Leave empty to use system default. Automatically sets SSL_CERT_FILE environment variable.

evaluator_options._comment_mode: 'rag' (default), 'agentic', or 'no-rag' (no retrieval — answers from the LLM's own training knowledge, a baseline to isolate how much of a normal answer's score comes from retrieval; correctness/relevance are graded, groundedness/retrieval_relevance are skipped since there are no retrieved documents). Takes priority over agentic_mode below if both are set.
evaluator_options._comment_agentic_mode: Older boolean-only knob, kept for backwards compatibility: if true (and mode is unset), the evaluator will use an agentic approach. Otherwise, RAG evaluation will be done.
